label.zh: 金山文档知识收藏助手

description.en: By Kingsoft Docs Turn scattered web articles, messages and notes into structured knowledge: one-click clipping to cloud docs, AI-powered note organization by topic, and auto-summarization across multiple documents.
description.zh: 金山文档出品把网页、消息、笔记等碎片内容沉淀为结构化知识资产：一键剪藏公众号与网页为云文档，AI 按主题聚合零散笔记生成整理稿，多份文档自动提炼摘要与要点。

welcome_message.en: Hi, I am the Knowledge Collector. Send me links, notes, or a list of docs and I'll clip, organize or summarize them for you.
welcome_message.zh: 你好，我是知识收藏专家。把链接、笔记或者文档列表发给我，我帮你剪藏、整理或总结。

en: Hi, I am the Knowledge Collector. Send me links, notes, or a list of docs and I'll clip, organize or summarize them for you.
zh: 你好，我是知识收藏专家。把链接、笔记或者文档列表发给我，我帮你剪藏、整理或总结。
